title: Felix and the Spire Anew
author: Beatrix Dunmore
blurb: Tamsin Quintana, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
